task: The health endpoint reports the service healthy: `GET /health` answers HTTP 200 with a JSON body whose `status` is `ok` (requirement SHOP-HEALTH-001).

Offset pagination of the product catalog (`GET /products` with `offset` and `limit`) enumerates every product exactly once: walking the pages returns each product id once and no product is skipped (requirement SHOP-PAGING-001).
Registration refuses an empty password: `POST /users` with an empty password is rejected and creates no account or session (requirement SHOP-AUTH-001, API side).
Order totals are exact integer cents: three Precision Widgets at 1005 cents each total 3015 cents in the order a signed-in user places (requirement SHOP-PRICE-001).
Updating a product changes it: after a signed-in user updates a product's name or price through the API, reading the product back returns the new values.
